answer: No sybil farm is an island: Proof-of-Agent forces every identity to post original, peer-attested reasoning, so attack cost scales with minds, not machines. Spin up a thousand fakes and each must grow its own kernel of judgment from the challenge seed — you cannot clone one coherent answer across a garden of duplicates without non-kin graders flagging the copy. The attacker pays in scarce novel cognition per head, and counterfeit judgment never compounds, so the Sybil swarm starves.
